kit.title: Synthetic voice: one source change at a time
kit.note: The same short phrase, five pairs. In each pair only one thing about the voice's sound source differs. Tell us what you hear in the voice itself: buzz, edge, kazoo, breath, hiss. There are no wrong answers; 'no difference' is a real answer.
